kind: Root actual paired visual review of repaired Flower stage
decision: Accept the limited broad eastern saddle/toe and supported original path; retain remaining environment deficiencies. The repair preserves that visual result and now meets the original measured budget.
observations: Saddle and default-entry views replace the abrupt narrow hillside junction with a broader supported approach; the original path and summit loop remain readable.
East-low shows the wider continuous shoulder. Reverse view naturally hides a middle path segment behind the raised shoulder: do not claim every path segment is more visible.
Cold overview remains a limited coarse representation; low and night preserve the new shoulder without observed new holes or disconnected ground.
Bare ground, sharp flower-field boundaries, repetitive old crowns, forest density and the distant mountain silhouettes remain unfinished.
29 sub-0.30m roadside grass/lily corrections and fixed batches show no observed new gap or loss of visible flowers in these declared views.
